description:
App installer and Windows setup toolkit - install a whole set of programs in one go.

Ven4Tools installs a chosen set of programs in one go from a curated, signed catalog: winget first, then a direct download verified by SHA256, then Chocolatey.
It also keeps installed programs up to date, manages Windows Update, removes built-in apps and runs basic diagnostics.
This package installs the Ven4Tools Launcher, which downloads, verifies and updates the Ven4Tools client.
